capitals.name: Cairo
capitals.note: Infobox 'Cairo, Egypt (Dec. 1948-1953)': the government 'was relocated to Cairo following the Israeli invasion in December 1948'. After 1953 'nominally dissolved, except the position of prime minister'. The page gives no seat after 1953 (only that the post of prime minister remained and Hilmi attended Arab League meetings), so the capital entry ends in 1953 although the life runs to June 1959.

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, no Cliopatria row (Cliopatria's 'Palestinians' row of 1948 is the West Bank, 18 cells, and its Kingdom of Egypt 1948-1952 shapes hold one Gaza cell). The page: 'its effective jurisdiction was limited to the All-Palestine Protectorate, which came to be called the Gaza Strip', while it 'claimed jurisdiction over the whole of the former Mandatory Palestine'; the 24 February 1949 armistice 'fixed the boundaries of the Gaza Strip'. The Gaza Strip is about two map cells. The page gives no area.

ledger.note: 22 September 1948: Egypt declares the All-Palestine Protectorate at Gaza. 'Egypt declared formation of the All-Palestine Protectorate on 22 September 1948'; the 1948 war page: 'the Arab League, led by Egypt, decided to set up the All-Palestine Government in Gaza on 8 September'. It was 'under official Egyptian protection' and 'had no executive role'. The land was Mandatory Palestine, whose mandate had ended; the kingdom-of-egypt dossier records the protectorate as a vassal relation.

ledger.note: 22 September 1948: the government is placed under Egyptian protection. 'Egypt declared formation of the All-Palestine Protectorate on 22 September 1948'; it 'was under official Egyptian protection' and 'had no executive role'. Mirrors kingdom-of-egypt's vassal_start of 1948-09 (counterpart all-palestine-government). The protection outlives the Kingdom (18 June 1953) and passes to the Republic of Egypt and, from 1958, to the United Arab Republic (their dossiers belong to other parts; this page does not date those changes of protector), so no vassal_end is written here: the relation runs to the June 1959 annulment.

ledger.note: June 1959: Nasser annuls the All-Palestine Government. 'In June 1959, Gamal Abdel Nasser officially annulled the All-Palestine Government by decree'; the nominal area 'was de jure merged into the United Arab Republic'. It had been 'nominally dissolved, except the position of prime minister' in 1953.

notes:
Written by group me-10-h as the Gaza counterpart of the Kingdom of Egypt (vassal_start 22 September 1948 in that dossier). The protectorate's Egyptian sovereign after 1953 is the Republic of Egypt (another part). The state was a nominal body and no contest event is written for it: the fighting at Gaza was Egypt's and is in the kingdom-of-egypt dossier (contest 15 May 1948 to 24 February 1949). The Gaza Strip is resolved as a 20 km circle around Gaza (about two cells). The page gives the infobox start as 22 September 1948 and the Arab League decision of the formal announcement on 20 September.

Repair round (2026-10-25): a vassal_start toward kingdom-of-egypt (1948-09) was added to mirror that dossier's event; it is left open-ended on purpose (see its note). Capitals: Cairo is given only to 1953 by the infobox ('Cairo, Egypt (Dec.1948-1953)'); the page names no seat for 1953-1959.
